weapon.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, inflicts Atk/Def-5 on foe during combat and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Def (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, inflicts Atk/Def-5 on foe during combat and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Def (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.

For unit and allies within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per attack (only highest value applied; does not stack), and grants Special cooldown count-1 before unit's or ally's first attack during combat.
Reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Def+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.

b.d: If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Def+2 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Def+4 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Def+6 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.
